summary: United Parcel Service, Inc. filed a prospectus supplement for a public offering of $325,105,000 Floating Rate Senior Notes due 2076, a routine debt issuance under an existing shelf registration. The notes bear interest at Compounded SOFR less 0.350%, are callable after 2056, and feature a 50-year maturity with put options. Proceeds to UPS are $321,853,950 after underwriting discount. Joint book-running managers are J.P. Morgan, Morgan Stanley, RBC Capital Markets, and UBS. This is an ordinary financing transaction with no special-situation elements.
